    # Merge only consecutive paths whose endpoints physically touch.
    if tolerance_mm < 0:
        raise GeometryError("merge tolerance must be non-negative")
    merged: list[Polyline] = []
    for line in polylines:
        if len(line) < 2:
            continue
        current = list(line)
        if merged and _distance(merged[-1][-1], current[0]) <= tolerance_mm:
            if _distance(merged[-1][-1], current[0]) > 1e-9:
                merged[-1].append(current[0])
            merged[-1].extend(current[1:])
        else:
            merged.append(current)
    return merged

uv run python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, tempfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import kobra_plot as kp

src = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150.svg"
gcode_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra.gcode"
preview_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra-preview.svg"
report_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra-report.json"
profile = kp.load_profile()
page_w = page_h = 150.0
page_x = 38.0
page_y = 58.0

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="botanical-exact-") as td:
    normalized = Path(td) / "normalized.svg"
    kp.normalize_svg(src, normalized)
    lines = kp.load_normalized_svg(normalized)
    root = ET.parse(normalized).getroot()
    vb = root.attrib.get("viewBox")
    if not vb:
        raise SystemExit("normalized SVG missing viewBox")
    vx, vy, vw, vh = [float(x) for x in vb.replace(",", " ").split()]
    if vw <= 0 or vh <= 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"bad normalized viewBox: {vb}")

    mapped = []
    for line in lines:
        out = []
        for x, y in line:
            px = (x - vx) / vw * page_w
            py = (y - vy) / vh * page_h
            if profile.orientation.swap_xy:
                px, py = py, px
            if profile.orientation.flip_x:
                px = page_w - px
            if profile.orientation.flip_y:
                py = page_h - py
            out.append((page_x + px, page_y + py))
        mapped.append(out)

    before = len(mapped)
    mapped = kp.merge_touching_polylines(mapped, tolerance_mm=0.02)
    after = len(mapped)
    b = kp.bounds(mapped)
    ws = profile.workspace
    if not (ws.draw_min_x <= b.min_x <= b.max_x <= ws.draw_max_x and ws.draw_min_y <= b.min_y <= b.max_y <= ws.draw_max_y):
        raise SystemExit(f"mapped botanical bounds outside safe envelope: {b}")

    gcode = kp.generate_gcode(mapped, profile)
    safety = kp.validate_gcode(gcode, profile)
    stats = kp.geometry_stats(mapped, profile)
    stats["output_bounds"] = b.as_dict()
    stats["polylines_before_touch_merge"] = before
    stats["polylines_after_touch_merge"] = after
    gcode_path.write_text(gcode, encoding="utf-8")
    preview_path.write_text(kp.render_preview(mapped, profile), encoding="utf-8")
    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "title": "Botanical engraving 150x150",
        "bounds_mm": {"min_x": round(b.min_x, 2), "max_x": round(b.max_x, 2), "min_y": round(b.min_y, 2), "max_y": round(b.max_y, 2)},
        "source": {"filename": src.name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "page_mm": [page_w, page_h], "machine_page_origin_mm": [page_x, page_y]},
        "geometry": stats,
        "profile": {"pen_up_z": profile.tool.pen_up_z, "pen_down_z": profile.tool.pen_down_z, "travel_feed": profile.motion.travel_feed, "draw_feed": profile.motion.draw_feed, "z_feed": profile.motion.z_feed},
        "safety": safety,
    }
    report["gcode_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(gcode.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("BOTANICAL_GEOMETRY", json.dumps(stats, sort_keys=True))
    print("BOTANICAL_GCODE_SHA256", report["gcode_sha256"])
PY
